name: tt1_solo
description: VUH-2340 solo route from FM-02 (Roxas, Day 6, Mansion Computer Room save point) to Yen Sid. Positions come from pilot door logs; extend from the last learned step.

steps.note: off the save point, west along the room
in front of the south-west doorway

steps.name: door-computer-to-basement-hall
steps.note: Computer Room 2/21 -> Basement Hall 2/19; trigger logged at (-234, -785)

steps.name: fight-basement-dusks
steps.note: Day 6 Dusk ambush; Reversal (react 69) is offered. A win moves the story to 2/20; Continue reloads at the Computer Room save point. Heal: Items is two rows below Attack, then Potion, then the target (Roxas)

steps.name: fight-axel
steps.note: Axel in 2/20, the arena ringed by fire. No backing off at low HP: it walks into the fire wall. Won 2026-10-17 (axel-01); the story then runs 20 -> 19 -> 18/3 -> 19
Basement Hall west wall, beside the corridor door
Basement Hall 2/19 -> Basement Corridor 2/22; trigger near (-921, -502)
corridor, in front of the north door

steps.name: door-corridor-to-pod-room
steps.note: Basement Corridor 2/22 -> 2/23; trigger near (-752, 556). The finale runs 23 -> 9 -> 23, then the forced party screen (camp menu 10: 'Party Members have been switched. Party In: Donald Goofy', OK highlighted; route-05). OK, then Space Space closes the Party screen and the camp menu. Nothing is saved. Sora wakes in The Woods 2/14
The Woods; tutorial boxes follow, the walk nudges them away

steps.name: door-woods-to-alley
steps.note: The Woods 2/14 -> 2/3; trigger near (-371, -3474). The Hayner/Pence/Olette scene follows and ends in the Usual Spot 2/2
Usual Spot 2/2 (save point: no reaction key) -> Back Alley 2/3; trigger near (369, 83). Reaction 604 is offered there
Back Alley, along the alley toward the sunset

Back Alley 2/3 -> Sandlot 2/4 near (694, -953); an event follows (route-06 teach). Sandlot exits: top-left, top-right (toward +x,+z, near 1160,1351), bottom-left; which leads on toward the station is not yet known
